headlines.snippet: A 14-year-old boy was killed and 24 others were injured by the explosion of unexploded ordnance during a trip in northern Israel. The victims were students and staff from a middle school in the ORT Ma'alot high school. The injured were evacuated to Rambam, Ziv, and Galilee Medical Centers, with three in serious condition. The IDF stated that the ordnance was likely a cluster bomb fired by Hezbollah during the war. It is being investigated whether a student brought the ordnance into their bag before it exploded. Dozens of Ministry of Education trips to the north have been diverted.
